records.finding: Bitnomial's own November 3, 2025 announcement says XRP and RLUSD margin deposits became available to institutional clients, subject to applicable approvals. Its current DCO page lists XRP collateral at a 40% haircut and $15M notional limit; XRP product maintenance margin is separately 17%. CFTC staff FAQ Q7-Q8 addresses DCO acceptance and monthly haircut review, while Q9-Q11 imposes a separate FCM notice and initial three-month restriction before other crypto assets may be accepted. Ripple's official disclosure identifies Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC as a registered FCM/broker-dealer, and Bitnomial lists that exact legal entity as a clearing member. This creates a direct clearing-network relationship and a conditional FCM collateral path, but no public notice, reliance date, customer XRP deposits or utilization was verified. Do not conflate DCO-level XRP acceptance with FCM-level acceptance from customers.
records.coinbase_strategy: Coinbase's official Q3 release reports 10.7% crypto trading-volume share, $22B average USDC held in Coinbase products, prediction markets above $200M annualized run-rate, derivatives volume growth and 49% of net revenue from subscription/services. Reuters reports transaction revenue fell 43% YoY and GAAP net income benefited from crypto-investment gains. This supports diversification but not immunity to crypto-market cycles; no XRP-specific capital flow is established.
records.circle_strategy: Circle and ACI announced a Colombia-focused USDC settlement pilot through ACI Connetic and Bre-B. It is an announced evaluation of USDC alongside existing rails, not measured production volume and not an XRPL-specific implementation. This is evidence of a parallel stablecoin distribution route, not proof of direct competition with Ripple on the same ledger.
records.market_data: TradRadar's 02:15 UTC panel shows price down 6.15%, OI down 7.74%, at least $31.86M liquidations (mostly longs), negative aggregate funding and 79.6% long-account share. The combination is consistent with deleveraging but mixed funding and account/notional distinctions prevent a directional inference. CryptoKeyhole's four-fund Oct 28 +4.338M XRP figure and XRP Insights' six-spot-plus-BITW provisional +174K XRP figure use different universes and are not combinable.
records.sbic: Official SBIC.co.jp identifies Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. and documents a March 5, 2026 ChatGPT/generative-AI seminar. It is an educational event with a Microsoft speaker, not evidence of OpenAI partnership or XRP/SBI Holdings relationship.
